briefings.title: Second Post-Cabinet Press Briefing 2026
briefings.primaryAgendaItem: Seasonal disease risks, urgent vaccine deployment and proposed contingency funding
briefings.summary: Cabinet reviewed seasonal disease risks, vaccine deployment needs and contingency funding in the context of elevated rainy-season public-health risks.

briefings.title: Seventh Post-Cabinet Press Briefing 2026
briefings.primaryAgendaItem: Update on tobacco production and marketing

briefings.title: Ninth Post-Cabinet Press Briefing 2026
briefings.primaryAgendaItem: National Formalisation Strategy
briefings.summary: Cabinet approved the National Formalisation Strategy addressing transition from informal to formal economic activity.

briefings.title: Tenth Post-Cabinet Press Briefing 2026
briefings.primaryAgendaItem: Minerals value chain: mining to beneficiation, industrialisation and exportation
briefings.summary: Cabinet approved a minerals value-chain framework linking mining, beneficiation, industrialisation and exports.

briefings.title: Eleventh Post-Cabinet Press Briefing 2026

briefings.summary: Cabinet considered the Second Round Crop, Livestock and Fisheries Assessment and remedial measures affecting cotton production.

briefings.title: Twelfth Post-Cabinet Press Briefing 2026
briefings.primaryAgendaItem: 2025/2026 summer crops marketing and 2026 winter crops production plan

briefings.summary: Cabinet approved an update on the national response to drug and substance abuse.

briefings.title: Sixteenth Post-Cabinet Press Briefing 2026
briefings.primaryAgendaItem: Summer crops marketing, winter production and irrigation insights
briefings.summary: Cabinet reviewed summer crop marketing, winter production and mechanisation and irrigation insights, noting a positive national food-security outlook.

briefings.title: Eighteenth Post-Cabinet Press Briefing 2026

briefings.title: Nineteenth Post-Cabinet Press Briefing 2026
briefings.primaryAgendaItem: End-of-cycle report on implementation of priority projects for the 1st 100-Day Cycle of 2026
briefings.summary: Cabinet reviewed implementation progress for priority projects in the first 100-Day Cycle of 2026.

briefings.title: Twentieth Post-Cabinet Press Briefing 2026
briefings.primaryAgendaItem: Summer crops marketing and 2026 winter crops production plan
briefings.summary: Cabinet reviewed summer crop marketing and winter production, including grain stocks and farmer payment arrangements; it also approved the Zimbabwe Sugarcane Industry Development Plan 2026-2035.

briefings.title: Twenty-First Post-Cabinet Press Briefing 2026

briefings.title: Twenty-Third Post-Cabinet Press Briefing 2026
briefings.primaryAgendaItem: Repatriation and reintegration of Zimbabwean nationals from South Africa
briefings.summary: Cabinet reviewed arrangements for repatriation and reintegration of Zimbabwean nationals returning from South Africa.

briefings.title: Twenty-Fourth Post-Cabinet Press Briefing 2026
briefings.primaryAgendaItem: Repatriation and reintegration of Zimbabwean nationals returning from South Africa
briefings.summary: Cabinet received a further update on repatriation and reintegration of Zimbabwean nationals returning from South Africa.

briefings.title: Twenty-Fifth Post-Cabinet Press Briefing 2026
briefings.primaryAgendaItem: Whole-of-Government response to illegal and unregulated urban mining
briefings.summary: Cabinet approved a coordinated national response to illegal urban mining, including a national taskforce, stronger enforcement and review of penalties, after environmental, infrastructure and public-health harms were identified.

briefings.title: Twenty-Sixth Post-Cabinet Press Briefing 2026
briefings.primaryAgendaItem: Summer crops marketing, winter production and review of licences, permits, levies and fees
briefings.summary: Cabinet reviewed crop and livestock assessment indicators, grain stocks and winter production, and approved further streamlining of licences, permits, levies and fees across agriculture and other sectors.

briefings.title: Twenty-Seventh Post-Cabinet Press Briefing 2026
briefings.primaryAgendaItem: Lake Kariba passenger ferry disaster, repatriation and national infrastructure updates
briefings.summary: Cabinet reviewed the Lake Kariba passenger ferry disaster and ongoing repatriation and reintegration of Zimbabwean nationals from South Africa, while also considering energy, education and national development matters.

briefings.title: Twenty-Eighth Post-Cabinet Press Briefing 2026
briefings.primaryAgendaItem: Agriculture and food security, 2030 Agenda review, mining industrialisation, SADC and South Africa cooperation
briefings.summary: Cabinet reviewed strong maize, tobacco and winter crop performance, approved Zimbabwe’s fourth voluntary national review of the 2030 Agenda, considered mining industrialisation lessons, and noted SADC and Zimbabwe-South Africa cooperation outcomes including regional foot-and-mouth disease control.

briefings.title: Twenty-Ninth Post-Cabinet Press Briefing 2026
briefings.primaryAgendaItem: Implementation of business licensing reforms and e-hailing review; priority projects; Lake Kariba disaster response; 2026/27 rainfall outlook
briefings.summary: Cabinet reviewed implementation of approved licences, permits, levies and fees and approved transitional measures for e-hailing services; adopted the mid-cycle report for the second 100-day cycle; approved immediate measures for communities affected by the Lake Kariba ferry disaster; received the 2026/27 rainfall outlook indicating elevated El Nino-related dryness risk; reviewed the Zimbabwe Agricultural Show and Sanganai/Hlanganani preparations; and received regional and international engagement reports.

briefings.title: Thirtieth Post-Cabinet Press Briefing 2026
briefings.primaryAgendaItem: 2026/27 drought resilience plan; Harare vending formalisation; health sector update; climate and international cooperation
briefings.summary: Cabinet approved the 2026/27 Summer Plan incorporating a six-pillar drought plan, measures to address informal vending in Harare, the July 2026 health-sector update, the Chartered Secretaries (Private) Amendment Bill, and a Zimbabwe-Sweden environment and climate cooperation MoU. Cabinet also received reports on solar cooperation, Zimbabwe-China economic and technical cooperation, the Non-Aligned Movement commemoration and Zimbabwe's participation at the 76th WHO Regional Committee for Africa.

highlights.detail: Cabinet approved six resilience pillars: enhanced Strategic Grain Reserve; accelerated climate-smart production; integrated financing; livestock drought mitigation; enhanced imports; and coordination, early-warning systems and capacity-building.

National cereal production for 2026/27 is expected at 1.6 million metric tonnes, with a Strategic Grain Reserve target of 600,000 metric tonnes and an expected cereal deficit of 266,881 to 541,881 metric tonnes.
The private sector will be allowed to import to meet commercial needs for both food and feed, while household basic-food import provisions will continue and are to be reviewed upwards.
Cabinet approved measures based on Legislate, Provide, Formalise and Enforce, including servicing 100 vending sites, a new satellite market and a 60-day one-stop formalisation drive.
Cabinet approved the July 2026 Health Sector Update, noting implementation of the National Health Strategy 2026-2030 and epidemic preparedness.
Cabinet approved an MoU on environment, climate and sustainable natural-resource use, including enhanced weather and climate early-warning services.
Cabinet noted trade and investment cooperation, quarantine arrangements, value addition, e-commerce, digital trade, artificial intelligence and emerging technologies.
Cabinet approved Zimbabwe's report from RC76, including exploration of a Regional Medicines and Health Commodities Pooled Procurement Initiative.
